With the new Twelve South Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay adapter hitting shelves at $40, Amazon has refreshed its early Prime Day offers once again with a fresh round of discounts. 9to5Toys' lunch break feature today is headlined by up to $150 off M5 MacBook Air models, alongside an ongoing $500 price drop on the M5 Pro 2TB model, plus a new Amazon low on a single 2026 Apple AirTag 2. We're also tracking a $50 price drop on the Sharge metallic 300W smart display power bank, new lows on the Belkin 25W MagSafe charging stand lineup, as well as the official fall Prime Day deals from $32 on Eve Matter/HomeKit plugs, switches, power strips, and more. More details below.

Twelve South unveils its new Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay and Android Auto adapter

Early Prime Day deals have just kicked off, and Twelve South is ready to debut its new Airfly Drive today. This latest addition to the Airfly lineup is a CarPlay and Android Auto adapter, and it's officially on sale now at $39.99. The market is flooded with similar products (most of which aren't nearly as sleek-looking as this one), but Twelve South has finally joined the fray.

Full vehicle compatibility list for the new Twelve South Airfly Drive CarPlay and Android Auto adapter

Early Prime Day deal: up to $150 off M5 MacBook Air models

Beyond some quickly selling-out Apple official refurbished offers, Amazon's early Prime Day deals have brought the most ideal discounts yet on Apple's current-generation M5 MacBook Air, with up to $150 off select models right now.

There are three configurations worth noting right now — the base model, a 24GB 15-inch variant, as well as the mid-tier 13-inch model. If you insist on the others, we suggest waiting for now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 ($1,599 MSRP)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,399 ($1,499 MSRP)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,849 ($1,999 MSRP)

Both upgraded configurations are $150 off MSRP, while the base 15-inch sees a $100 discount. This is the discount level to buy at right now — the base model rarely sees deals, so a $100 cut is solid, but we'd wait for the upgraded configurations to hit $150 off.

This deal also joins what I consider one of the best MacBook deals in recent months — a $500 price drop on the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage.

This $500-off M5 Pro MacBook Pro may be the most attractive early Prime Day deal right now

Amazon's early Prime Day deals are in full swing, spanning thousands of price drops, but we want to highlight one particularly notable Apple offer before it disappears. What will become of the MacBook Pro lineup for next week's Prime Day is anyone's guess, but you can jump in early and grab this M5 Pro 2TB model for up to $500 off right now.

Amazon is now offering both the Space Black and Silver colorways of the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM, 2TB of storage, and the upgraded 18/20-core specs for $2,699 shipped.

Amazon all-time low: still available, a single 2026 Apple AirTag 2

We've covered the 4-pack deals several times, but if you don't need four, Amazon's early Prime Day offers continue to bring the brand-new, unopened 2026 Apple AirTag 2 to a new low.

While it's not a massive price drop — just $24 shipped for Prime members — keep in mind this is Apple's newer 2026 release, which already retails for just $29.

  • AirTag 2 $24 ($29 MSRP) — matching all-time low

The 4-pack is also still on sale at $89, which works out to $22.50 each, but we've seen it dip as low as $9 over the past few months and expect it could return during fall Prime Day.

Apple Refurbished Store: most affordable 2026 Studio Display models see instant discounts of up to $300

As Amazon's early Prime Day deals continue, the Apple Certified Refurbished Store is also offering notable savings on the most affordable 2026 Apple Studio Display models — $240 off the tilt-adjustable stand version, and $300 off the tilt-and-height-adjustable stand version.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is once again offering the 2026 Apple Studio Display with tilt-adjustable stand for $1,359 shipped. That model normally retails for $1,599 and is now $240 below MSRP; Amazon currently sells it for $1,550 and has never dropped below $1,484.

The 2026 model with the tilt-and-height-adjustable stand is now available for $1,699 shipped. This display normally retails for $1,999 and is now a substantial $300 below MSRP — well below Amazon's current $1,984 price; that model has never dropped below $1,886 new at Amazon.

Eve's official fall Prime Day deals kick off: up to 38% off Matter/HomeKit switches, plugs, power strips, and more from $30

While Prime Big Deal Days doesn't technically start until next week, Eve has informed 9to5Toys that its official fall Prime Day deals on Amazon will launch today. A wide range of the brand's well-regarded HomeKit and Matter-compatible smart home products will be available at Prime Big Deal Days pricing, with up to 38% off. Head over to the brand's official Amazon storefront to shop, and see more details below.

Eve is indeed one of those brands that runs deals year-round, but it's only during these special promotional events that prices truly dip significantly. Its extensive lineup of multi-smart-home-platform, Matter-compatible products — from outlets and smart plugs, to light switches, water leak detectors, motion sensors, and Motionblinds — are all currently available at fall Prime Day pricing.
